profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, trading under the ticker DDOG and also listed as DATADOG INC - CLASS A. Its site presents its core offering as cloud monitoring as a service, which the company describes as letting customers see metrics from all of their apps, tools and services in one place, with a free trial available.

The site's messaging also covers security. Datadog describes integrating security and observability so organizations can decode runtime execution, reduce exposure in dynamic AI environments, and run detection and response at what it calls agentic speed against AI-powered attacks. No specific products or MCP servers are tracked for the company in the material reviewed here.

Corporate records give the company CIK 0001561550. New York is listed as a jurisdiction with 459 cases involving the company, and no individual cases are named.
